b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line HTTP file downloader with retry support.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | What to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | File to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | No progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin

# Download silently
tinydl https://example.com/file.bin -q
```
'
